description: Awarded the Star of the Quarter by senior leadership at Tata Consultancy Services for spearheading the migration of a business-critical middleware application that had failed to go live for over five years. As the infrastructure lead, I resolved complex network issues using tools like Wireshark, collaborated with client-side architects, and deployed high-availability AWS infrastructure via CloudFormation in a restricted AMS environment. My proactive leadership ensured end-to-end delivery across Dev, QA, UAT, and Prod environments, despite the unexpected resignation of our team lead.
impact: Successfully executed a migration that had failed in 4 prior attempts over 5 years. Reduced infra build time through automation, maintained 100% compliance, and enabled real-time integration with 40+ dependent systems. Earned trust from client architects, received a LinkedIn recommendation, and was chosen to lead additional large-scale AWS migration projects before transitioning to higher studies.
title: Star of the Quarter – Q3 2023 (Tata Consultancy Services)

description: Awarded First Place at I2CONECCT-2021, a national-level project exhibition held at Sahyadri College of Engineering and Management in association with IEEE Mangalore Subsection. The recognition was for “TapShip – Tap to Ship,” an innovative final-year project that empowers farmers across India to list agricultural produce on a bidding-based digital marketplace, enabling customers nationwide to purchase directly and arrange seamless logistics through verified transporters. The project was developed with a strong focus on innovation and humanitarian impact within the agriculture and logistics ecosystem.
impact: Created meaningful impact in the agriculture sector by building a scalable, farmer-centric platform that promotes transparency in crop pricing, eliminates middlemen, and facilitates last-mile logistics. The solution bridges the gap between rural producers and urban consumers, highlighting the power of digital innovation for social good.
title: First Place:TapShip Project at I2CONECCT-2021
